'''Hokkeji''' (法華寺) is a [[Rinzai school|Zen Buddhist temple]] of the [[Rinzai School Myoshinji branch|Myōshin-ji sect]] located in [[Suwa, Nagano|Suwa City]], [[Nagano Prefecture]], in the [[Nakasu Shinjūji|Shinjūji Nakasu]] area of Nakasu (中洲) with the address 856.

== History ==
In the [[Kamakura period]], [[Suwa Morishige]] served as a [[Naishi (court lady)|Court lady]] to the [[Kamakura shogunate|Kamakura Shogunate]]. He practiced Zen under [[Lanxi Daolong|Daikaku Zendo Doryu]], reforming from the previous [[Tiantai|Tendai School]] to establish the temple's revival and founding.

During the [[Tenshō (Momoyama period)|Tenshō Era]] 10 (1582) [[Koshu campaign|Kōshū Conquest]], [[Oda Nobunaga]] stayed at Hokkeji from March 19 to April 2, conducting the [[Koshin region|Kōshin region]] land distribution and issuing national laws. The ''[[Nobunaga ki|shinchouki]]'' records, "On March 19, I stayed at Suwa Hokkeji, commanding my men on the Ranks as I instructed."

During the [[Meiji Restoration]], the temple was largely destroyed except for the main hall and kitchen due to [[Haibutsu kishaku]]. However, it was restored in [[1899|Meiji 32]] (1899).

== Overview ==
Adjacent to the [[Suwa Taisha Upper Shrine]], Hokkeji enshrines the main deity [[Shakyamuni Tathāgata Buddha]] with an inscription from [[Einin|Eiji era]] 2 (1294), depicted in a [[Sanmon format|Three Sages of Avatamsaka]] holding [[Samantabhadra (Bodhisattva)|Fugen Bosatsu]] and [[Manjushri|Monju Bosatsu]] as attendants.

At the top of the stone steps stands an [[East Asian hip-and-gable roof|Irimoya-zukuri]] style two-story gate, and the main hall facing front was rebuilt in [[Meiwa|Meiwa era]] 2 (1765). Behind the Sutra Platform (須弥壇), there is a hall of tablets (位牌堂) housing a wooden statue of [[Daikaku Zendo]] as a [[Chinsō|Daiyō]], along with statues of [[Daruma Daishi]] and [[Dentai Daishi]].

On the rear mountain of the temple lies the grave of [[Yoshinobu Kira]], who was exiled following the [[Forty-seven rōnin|Ako Incident]] and entrusted to the [[Suwa Domain]].

== Access ==
* From [[Chūō Main Line|JR Chuo Line]] [[Kami-Suwa Station]] via [[Suwa Bus]] "Jousha" stop, approximately 3 minutes.
